predictions.articleTitle: Furiani-Agliani vs Nancy Prediction & Match Analysis: Can Corsican Leaders Disrupt Ligue 2 Defense?
predictions.coreRecommendation: Support Nancy via Draw / Away Win in 90 minutes, anchored on a 1:2 away victory with Over 2.5 Goals and BTTS: Yes.
possibilityAssessment: Draw / Away Win led by Nancy's Ligue 2 quality and five-match winning run (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Over 2.5 Goals & BTTS: Yes built on Furiani-Agliani's 2.10 goals-per-game fourth-tier attack and Nancy's away firepower (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
1:1 90-minute draw contingency if synthetic-turf friction and unconfirmed cup rotation force penalties (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Low)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Fourth-tier leaders test Ligue 2 promotion contenders on Corsican synthetic turf.

spf.comment: Covers Nancy's two-division edge in a 1:2 away win alongside a 1:1 90-minute draw, as unconfirmed cup lineups and Corsican synthetic turf weaken a single away-win call.

over_under.comment: Furiani-Agliani's 2.10 goals per game in National 2 Groupe A and Nancy's recent four-goal and three-goal cup/road outputs point past 2.5 goals.

btts.comment: Furiani-Agliani's home scoring output can breach a rotated or stretched Nancy backline that conceded three at Béthunois, while Nancy's Ligue 2 attack should reply.

score.comment: 1:2 captures Nancy pulling clear late after a home strike; 1:1 covers a disciplined Corsican stalemate heading to penalties.

goals.comment: Three goals align with a competitive 1:2 away win, while two goals cover a tighter 1:1 cup deadlock.

bqc.comment: A level first half reflects early Corsican organization before Nancy's Ligue 2 depth either breaks through (Draw-Loss) or settles for a 90-minute draw (Draw-Draw).
